So think twice before you go to Alankar.

featured_reviews.name: Suruchi Luthra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have tried several stores of Lenskart. Their products are fine. However, I faced issues with their in-store service.

First, my spectacles needed adjustment but the staff could not fix them properly. They did not use proper tools like pliers or a frame heater to adjust the frame or nose pads and kept trying to adjust the temples by hand. Even after visiting multiple Lenskart stores, the problem was not solved. A local optical shop fixed it in five minutes.

Second, after replacing lenses in a frame originally purchased from Lenskart, my vision was not clear. It seemed like the lens power or axis alignment was not fitted correctly. The staff kept blaming the frame and refused to adjust it with proper tools or heat. Later, I got other lenses fitted again in the same frame and my vision became perfectly clear, showing the frame was not the issue.

While Lenskart products and pricing are good, their in-store technical service, lens fitting, and troubleshooting need improvement.
